projectDescription: A CLI tool and Go library for generating Software Bill of Materials (SBOMs) from container images, filesystems, and archives.
keyFeatures: SBOM generation from container images (Docker, OCI, Singularity)
SBOM generation from local filesystems and archives
Support for 40+ package ecosystems (Alpine, Debian, RPM, Go, Python, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Rust, PHP, .NET, and more)
Multiple SBOM output formats: CycloneDX JSON/XML, SPDX JSON/Tag-Value, Syft JSON
SBOM format conversion between supported standards
Signed SBOM attestations via in-toto specification
Seamless integration with Grype vulnerability scanner
Usable as a Go library with a clean public API
Extensible cataloger system with custom cataloger support
publicApiSurface: syft.GetSource(ctx, userInput, cfg) — resolve any input string to a scannable source
syft.CreateSBOM(ctx, src, cfg) — catalog a source and produce an SBOM
syft.DefaultCreateSBOMConfig() — construct default SBOM configuration
syft.DefaultGetSourceConfig() — construct default source detection configuration
syft.SetLogger(logger) — configure the logger for the syft library
syft.SetBus(bus) — configure the event bus for the syft library
format.Encode(sbom, encoder) — serialize an SBOM to bytes
format.Decode(reader) — deserialize bytes into an SBOM
format.Identify(reader) — detect the format of an SBOM byte stream
format.Encoders() — list all available format encoders
format.Decoders() — list all available format decoders
syftjson.NewFormatEncoder() — encoder for Syft JSON format
cyclonedxjson.NewFormatEncoder() — encoder for CycloneDX JSON format
cyclonedxxml.NewFormatEncoder() — encoder for CycloneDX XML format
spdxjson.NewFormatEncoder() — encoder for SPDX JSON format
spdxtagvalue.NewFormatEncoder() — encoder for SPDX Tag-Value format
CreateSBOMConfig.WithCatalogers(...) — add custom catalogers
CreateSBOMConfig.WithSearchConfig(cfg) — configure search scope
CreateSBOMConfig.WithRelationshipsConfig(cfg) — configure relationship tracking
source.SquashedScope, source.AllLayersScope, source.DeepSquashedScope — image scan scopes
CLI: syft scan <target> — scan a container image or filesystem
CLI: syft attest <target> — create a signed SBOM attestation
CLI: syft convert <sbom-file> — convert between SBOM formats
CLI: syft cataloger list — list available catalogers
CLI: syft packages <target> — alias for scan command
